newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- World Bank to extend $150 million a year in loans to Lebanon for the next five years.
- Saudi commerce minister hopes his country will join World Trade Organisation before the end of 1997.
- Qatar to start exporting liquefied natural gas to Japan next week.
- Qatar signs agreement with eight companies to construct an iron plant at a cost of 1.45 billion riyals.
- Saudi commerce minister says trade relations with the United States enter a new era.
